units.source_text: 时值晚秋，老师准备应邀参加一个老施主的葬礼，

en.t: It was late autumn, and the master was preparing to attend the funeral of an old patron at his invitation,

units.source_text: 这主人距此地约需两个多小时火车的路程，

en.t: the patron lived a little over two hours away from here by train,

units.source_text: 所以老师头天晚上就宣布他早晨五点半出发。

en.t: so the master announced the night before that he would leave at five thirty in the morning.
The assistant priest would accompany him.

units.source_text: 我们也为了赶得上老师的出门时间，

en.t: In order for us too to be ready in time for the master's departure,

units.source_text: 必须四点起床，做好清扫工作以及备好早餐。

en.t: we had to get up at four, finish the cleaning, and have breakfast prepared.
